title: Optimal Transport for Efficient, Unsupervised Anomaly Detection on Industrial Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.13940v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective anomaly detection frameworks are a central pillar of the Industry 4.0 paradigm. In this paper, we introduce an Optimal Transport (OT)-based framework for anomaly detection, designed to detect deviations from normal behaviour in time-series sensor data. The OT-based method requires minimal user input and adapts to real-time data without the need for labelled training data. Our method effectively addresses existing limitations related to data labelling, generalisability, and scalability, demonstrating resilience against short-term fluctuations, noise, and data gaps - common challenges in industrial environments. Additionally, our method provides counterfactual explanations improving the auditability of the approach when deployed in industrial settings. translated_title: 基于最优传输的工业数据高效无监督异常检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：有效的异常检测框架是工业4.0范式的核心支柱。本文提出了一种基于最优传输的异常检测框架，旨在检测时间序列传感器数据中与正常行为的偏差。该基于最优传输的方法只需极少的用户输入，且无需标记训练数据即可适应实时数据。我们的方法有效解决了现有技术在数据标注、泛化能力和可扩展性方面的局限，展现出对短期波动、噪声和数据缺失等工业环境常见挑战的鲁棒性。此外，我们的方法还提供了反事实解释，提高了该方法在工业环境中部署时的可审计性。所提出的方法通过一个能够适应数据动态变化的滑动参考窗口，学习正常工况与观测工况之间的映射关系。我们评估了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于最优传输的无监督异常检测框架，无需标注数据即可实时检测工业时间序列传感器数据中的异常，兼具对噪声和数据缺失的鲁棒性以及可审计的反事实解释能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an Optimal Transport-based unsupervised anomaly detection framework that detects deviations in industrial time-series sensor data in real time without labeled training data, offering robustness to noise and data gaps along with counterfactual explanations for auditability.
